Mize Signs Extension with Tigers
Team officials were upbeat today as <Casey Mize:player#40855> signed an extension with the <Tigers:team#10>. He'll be calling <Detroit:team#10> home for the next 4 years and will earn $72,000,000 in salary by the end of the contract. The <Tigers:team#10> GM said, "We're excited to know he'll be part of this team going forward. This is a good day for him, and we believe it makes the future for us better."

So far this season, <Mize:player#40855> has compiled a 4-4 record with a 3.31 ERA.
